rationale: Build entries by run 1-5: succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded, succeeded. Declared run-command probes: failed, succeeded, failed, failed, failed. Nonzero run probes lack required CLI arguments or standard input. They show incomplete invocation rather than a matched application-startup failure; scenario commands demonstrate operation when supplied valid inputs.
limitation: The declared commands were not re-observed with their required subcommands/input. Startup consistency cannot be inferred from these incomplete bare-command probes.

rationale: FR-008: the run 1 automated split exits successfully and produces both requested outputs. Run 2 workspace-run produces page files but then exits with error: int object is not iterable. The recorded automated-command completion differs. Reviewed coverage: 18/23 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 61/115 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: The commands use different delivered CLI protocols; the comparison concerns completing their declared automated task. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.

rationale: FR-024: repeating a merge at an existing destination in run 1 fails and requires --overwrite. In run 5 the repeated merge completes with code 0 and no explicit overwrite option. The recorded repeated-output handling differs. Reviewed coverage: 1/2 requirements have an observed status in at least one run; 5/10 requirement-run cells have an observed status. These counts describe coverage, not stability.
limitation: Both merges use identical inputs, so run 5 does not establish whether bytes were rewritten or an existing output was reused. Unobserved branches cannot establish further variation; no causal attribution to SRS omissions is made.
